raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions contains 27 txn_ids with two versions that differ in amount and record_version (1 vs 2). The pipeline deduplicates nothing, so both copies reach silver. The fix keeps only the highest record_version per txn_id across all statuses, then applies the POSTED filter, so a superseding REVERSED version is not overridden by an older POSTED copy.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) AS latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
